name: label-image-mcp
description: Annotate histopathology images: StarDist nuclei, SAM/MedSAM outlines, QC, COCO/YOLO/QuPath export.
long_description: Lets Claude list, upload and describe images saved in Image Label (labels.sachin-kale.com), add or clean up annotations, and export COCO or YOLO training data. Needs an Image Label account to upload or save annotations.

username.title: Username
username.description: Image Label account username. Leave empty for read-only access.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Only change this to use a different deployment

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List saved images, optionally filtered by category

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get an image's metadata, annotations and viewing URL

tools.name: update_image_metadata
tools.description: Update an image's name, category or description

tools.name: replace_annotations
tools.description: Replace all annotations on an image

tools.name: upload_image_from_url
tools.description: Download an image from an https URL and upload it to Image Label

tools.name: warm_up_segmentation
tools.description: Start loading the segmentation model in the background ahead of segment_objects

tools.name: segment_objects
tools.description: Trace precise outlines with Segment Anything (SAM, or MedSAM for medical images) from rough boxes or points, and save them as polygons

tools.name: detect_nuclei
tools.description: Find and outline every cell nucleus in an H&E histology image with StarDist, marking enlarged nuclei

tools.name: normalize_stain
tools.description: Standardise an H&E image's colours (Macenko stain normalization), saved as a new image

tools.name: check_image_quality
tools.description: HistoQC-style checks of a histology image: tissue, blur, marker pen, exposure, faint staining

tools.name: warm_up_pathology
tools.description: Start loading the nuclei model in the background ahead of detect_nuclei

tools.name: export_annotations
tools.description: Export annotations as COCO JSON, YOLO or QuPath GeoJSON
